label: Bug-10
title: Cannot create user-story nodes - label validation fails
description:
When trying to create a new user-story node, the backend returns a validation error:

```
ValueError: in Safe_Str__Node_Label, value does not match required pattern: ^[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*-\d{1,5}$
```

## Root Cause
The label validation pattern `^[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*-\d{1,5}$` requires:
- Start with capital letter
- Followed by lowercase letters only
- Then a hyphen and 1-5 digits

This pattern does NOT support hyphenated node type names like `user-story` which would produce labels like `User-story-1`.

## Reproduction Steps
1. Open Issues UI v0.1.4
2. Click '+ New'
3. Select 'User-story' type
4. Enter a title
5. Click 'Create User-story'
6. Error appears: validation pattern mismatch

## Note
Creating tasks, bugs, features, versions all work fine - only user-story fails because of the hyphen in the type name.

## Suggested Fix
Update the backend validation pattern to support hyphenated type names:
```python
# Old pattern
^[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*-\d{1,5}$

# New pattern (supports hyphens in type)
^[A-Z][a-zA-Z]*(-[a-zA-Z]+)*-\d{1,5}$
```

Or alternatively, use underscore for user_story internally.
